purpose: Canonical tracker for unavoidable Owner-only manual actions. AI must minimize these and recheck immediately after Owner completion.

actions.title: Protect main with an active GitHub branch ruleset
actions.reason_owner_only: The connected GitHub tool can read rulesets/branch protection but does not expose repository-administration write actions for creating them.

current_evidence.verification_method: Create this authority change on a non-main branch, open PR to main, require authority + continuity to pass, then merge through protected main. Mark PASS only after this PR path succeeds.

target_configuration.note: No manual review approval or signed commits are required. Normal AI changes use branch -> PR -> required CI -> merge.

actions.completion_evidence: Protected-main PR flow succeeds only after authority + continuity checks pass, with no direct-main workflow needed.
actions.after_owner_completion: AI verifies through the protected PR flow and then updates this action to PASS.
